correctness.rationale: Permutation averaging preserves the trace observable and reduces the density equation to hub population p, common leaf population a, leaf coherence b and imaginary hub-leaf coherence y. Integrated linear ODE yields P=1/kappa, Y=-1/(2mJ), B=-1/(m gamma); hence the stated T. Positive dephasing eliminates invariant loss-free states, and separate reciprocal-plus-linear terms yield unique optimum. The exactly coherent dark fraction (m-1)/m follows from orthogonal decomposition. Independent full Lindblad resolvents checked 24 cases for m=2..5 and varied rates/hopping, including hub and leaf initial states.

All main present conclusions are restrictions or elementary integrations of the stronger previous results.
